question.text: Economic Value Added (EVA) is calculated by subtracting which of the following from net after-tax operating profit?

answer.text: Product of invested capital and percentage cost of capital

explanation.text: The Logic: EVA = Net after-tax operating profit - (Invested capital × Cost of capital). It measures true economic profit by accounting for the opportunity cost of capital employed. Positive EVA indicates the company is creating value above its cost of capital. The Trap: Some candidates confuse EVA with EBITDA or MVA. EVA specifically deducts the capital charge from operating profit.
